senses.gloss: , only in fem. הוּגֶּנֶת (= מְהוּגֶּנֶת, v. הָגַן; cmp. הוֹגָן) befitting, corresponding to; well-regulated.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 12:6">Yeb. XII, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Yevamot 106b:1">106ᵇ</cite>) <he>עצה הה׳ לו</he> an advice befitting his case.

<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 8:5">Gitt. VIII, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Gittin 79b:14">79ᵇ</cite>) <he>לשום מלכות שאינה ה׳</he> (Mish. <he>אהרת</he>) in the name of a government not corresponding (to the country in which the document was written, or not recognized in the country).

<cite ref="Kiddushin 70a:7">Kidd. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>אשה שאינה ה׳ לו</he> a wife beneath the social standing of her husband (eventually degrading the priestly status of the issue); Y. Gitt. I, 43ᶜ bot.; a. fr.—Pl. (from <he>הָגוּן</he>, v. <cite ref="E00076"><he>הָגַן</he></cite>) <he>הֲגוּנוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 93a:2">Snh. 93ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ לכהונה</he> fit to be married by priests.
